overview: The dependency graph is straightforward: task-api has no dependencies and forms the foundation, while task-web depends on task-api. A bottom-up strategy is applied, building the API and its data layer first so the frontend has a fully-defined, running contract to integrate against. This eliminates the need for mocking and ensures authentication flows, validation rules, and response shapes are established before any UI code is written.

phases.name: Foundation Services
phases.description: The task-api service has no upstream component dependencies and owns all data persistence, authentication, and business logic. It must be built and verified first so the frontend can be developed and tested against real endpoints.

components.name: task-api
responsibilities: Authenticate users via JWT (register, login, logout, password reset) and enforce session expiry
Manage user accounts including profile updates, password changes, and full account deletion with cascading data removal
Provide full CRUD operations for tasks, enforcing per-user ownership on every query
Provide full CRUD operations for categories, uncategorizing tasks on category deletion
Filter, sort, and search tasks dynamically via query parameters and compute derived fields such as is_overdue
components.architectureContext: This is the sole backend service in the system. It is called exclusively by task-web over HTTPS using JWT bearer tokens. It connects outbound to PostgreSQL for all data persistence and to an SMTP server for password reset emails. No other component depends on it indirectly — it is the single source of truth for all application data.
keyConsiderations: Dynamic SQL construction for task filtering must use a strict column whitelist for sort_by to prevent SQL injection; use parameterized queries for all user-supplied values.
JWT secret and DATABASE_URL must be injected via environment variables and validated at startup — fail fast with a clear error if either is missing.
Password reset tokens must be stored as bcrypt hashes (not plaintext) and the raw token sent only once via email; the confirm endpoint must mark tokens used atomically to prevent replay.
Embedded SQL migrations must run idempotently on startup (e.g. using IF NOT EXISTS) so container restarts are safe without a separate migration step.
The /health endpoint must perform an actual DB ping and return 503 if unreachable, enabling Docker/orchestrator liveness probes to gate traffic correctly.
components.apiContract:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Task API
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9090
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                    example: ok

  /api/auth/register:
    post:
      summary: Register a new user
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [email, password]
              properties:
                email:
                  type: string
                  format: email
                password:
                  type: string
                  minLength: 8
                display_name:
                  type: string
      responses:
        '201':
          description: User created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'
        '409':
          description: Email already in use

  /api/auth/login:
    post:
      summary: Log in
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [email, password]
              properties:
                email:
                  type: string
                password:
                  type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Authenticated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthResponse'
        '401':
          description: Invalid credentials

  /api/auth/logout:
    post:
      summary: Log out
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Session ended

  /api/auth/password-reset/request:
    post:
      summary: Request password reset email
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [email]
              properties:
                email:
                  type: string
                  format: email
      responses:
        '202':
          description: Reset email sent if account exists

  /api/auth/password-reset/confirm:
    post:
      summary: Confirm password reset with token
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [token, password]
              properties:
                token:
                  type: string
                password:
                  type: string
                  minLength: 8
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Password updated
        '400':
          description: Invalid or expired token

  /api/users/me:
    get:
      summary: Get current user profile
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: User profile
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
    patch:
      summary: Update display name or email
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                display_name:
                  type: string
                email:
                  type: string
                  format: email
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated user
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
    delete:
      summary: Delete account and all data
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Account deleted

  /api/users/me/password:
    put:
      summary: Change password while logged in
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [current_password, new_password]
              properties:
                current_password:
                  type: string
                new_password:
                  type: string
                  minLength: 8
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Password changed
        '401':
          description: Current password incorrect

  /api/categories:
    get:
      summary: List all categories for the current user
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of categories
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
    post:
      summary: Create a category
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [name]
              properties:
                name:
                  type: string
                color:
                  type: string
                  description: Hex color code
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Category created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        '409':
          description: Category name already exists for user

  /api/categories/{id}:
    patch:
      summary: Rename or update a category
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                name:
                  type: string
                color:
                  type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated category
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        '404':
          description: Category not found
    delete:
      summary: Delete a category (tasks become uncategorized)
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Category deleted

  /api/tasks:
    get:
      summary: List tasks with optional filters and sorting
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: category_id
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
        - name: status
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [all, active, completed]
        - name: priority
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [low, medium, high]
        - name: due
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [today, this_week, overdue]
        - name: search
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: sort_by
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [due_date, created_at, priority, title]
        - name: sort_dir
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [asc, desc]
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Filtered and sorted task list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
    post:
      summary: Create a task
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskInput'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Task created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'

  /api/tasks/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get a single task
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Task detail
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '404':
          description: Task not found
    patch:
      summary: Update a task
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskInput'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated task
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
    delete:
      summary: Delete a task
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Task deleted

  /api/tasks/{id}/complete:
    patch:
      summary: Toggle task completion status
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [completed]
              properties:
                completed:
                  type: boolean
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated task
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'

components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  responses:

      description: Validation failed
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              errors:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    field:
                      type: string
                    message:
                      type: string
  schemas:
    AuthResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        token:
          type: string
        user:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
    User:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        email:
          type: string
        display_name:
          type: string
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    Category:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
        color:
          type: string
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    Task:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        title:
          type: string
        description:
          type: string
          nullable: true
        due_date:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          nullable: true
        category_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          nullable: true
        priority:
          type: string
          enum: [low, medium, high]
        completed:
          type: boolean
        is_overdue:
          type: boolean
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    TaskInput:
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 200
        description:
          type: string
          nullable: true
        due_date:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          nullable: true
        category_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          nullable: true
        priority:
          type: string
          enum: [low, medium, high]

phases.name: Frontend Application
phases.description: task-web depends on task-api being available for all API communication. With the backend contract fully defined and running, the React SPA can be built with confidence against real endpoints, enabling accurate integration of auth flows, error shapes, and filter/sort behavior.

components.name: task-web
responsibilities: Render the full task management UI including task list, task detail, category sidebar, and filter/sort controls
Manage authentication state and JWT lifecycle, including inactivity-based session expiry and global 401 interception
Communicate with task-api via typed fetch wrappers, attaching bearer tokens and surfacing structured API errors to the user
Enforce client-side input validation for all forms (registration, login, task creation, settings) before submission
Serve as a static SPA via nginx with SPA fallback routing and a /health endpoint
components.architectureContext: task-web is the sole client of task-api. It calls all task-api endpoints over HTTPS using JWT bearer tokens obtained at login. It has no backend of its own — nginx serves the static Vite build and handles SPA routing. VITE_API_BASE_URL must point to the deployed task-api instance at build time.
keyConsiderations: JWT must be stored in memory (not localStorage) with sessionStorage as a page-refresh fallback to limit XSS exposure; the inactivity timer must reset on any user interaction event and clean up on logout.
The search input must be debounced 300ms before triggering an API call to avoid request flooding; all active filters must be sent as a combined query string on every change.
Optimistic UI for task completion toggle (immediately flip the checkbox, revert on API error) is required to meet the 2-second interactivity target and feel responsive.
Route-level code splitting via React.lazy + Suspense is required to keep initial bundle size low enough to hit the 2-second load target on normal network conditions.
The nginx.conf must include a try_files fallback to index.html for all non-asset routes so that deep-linking and browser refresh work correctly in the SPA.
components.apiContract:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Task Web Application
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Static SPA served by nginx. No backend API of its own.
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check served by nginx
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
                example: ok
